mainEntity.name: How can I measure the effectiveness of AEO for my cosmetic surgery practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: Measuring AEO effectiveness involves tracking metrics beyond traditional website traffic. Look at the number of featured snippets your content appears in using tools like Google Search Console. Monitor impressions and click-through rates from these snippets, even for zero-click searches, as they indicate enhanced visibility. Track voice search query performance if your website analytics support it. Ultimately, success is also measured by an increase in qualified leads, direct inquiries mentioning your online presence, and appointment bookings directly attributable to your content being featured as an answer. Conversion tracking from these touchpoints is key.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure AEO by tracking featured snippet appearances, impressions, and voice search performance. Ultimately, increased qualified leads and appointments indicate effectiveness.
